destination.title: Inflationary dynamics and conditional viability across effective models
destination.question: How do specified gravitational, kinetic and dissipative models affect inflationary dynamics, observables and conditional consistency tests, including connections to reheating and late acceleration?
destination.summary: This is a proposed browsing scope. Numerical membership does not establish common assumptions, question equivalence or successful reconciliation. Overlapping cards distinguish mechanisms, dynamical regimes and cosmological targets.

systems: Curvature-based and nonminimally coupled gravity models
Canonical, noncanonical, tachyonic, supersymmetric and multiple-field inflation models
targets: Inflationary observables and source-specific parameter comparisons
Reheating, primordial gravitational waves and late acceleration where explicitly studied
regimes: Slow roll and constant roll remain distinct
Cold, warm and dissipative cases remain distinct
High-energy brane calculations do not cover the full density range
Eternal self-reproduction and singularity repair are adjacent targets
assumptions: Each model retains its own field content, action, dimensional setting and validity conditions
Swampland criteria are conditional inputs where invoked, not required premises of every member
Numerical selections and source-reported fits are not independently verified here
conventions: Retain each source's observational date and version
Potential derivatives, field normalization and conjecture branches are model-specific
Conjecture compatibility does not demonstrate an ultraviolet completion
includes: Structural and methodological questions alongside phenomenological tests
excludes: A universal affirmative claim that modified inflation satisfies swampland criteria
An assumption that all models have one field, one dimension or one gravitational framework
Unverified claims of current observational agreement

sources.title: Modified F(R) Horava-Lifshitz gravity: a way to accelerating FRW cosmology

evidence.text: Can a foliation-preserving generalization of F(R) gravity have consistent Hamiltonian constraints and spatially flat FRW dynamics supporting both early inflation and late acceleration?

sources.title: The zoo plot meets the swampland: mutual (in)consistency of single-field inflation, string conjectures, and cosmological data

evidence.text: Can the proposed swampland restrictions coexist with CMB-compatible single-field inflation? The paper adds scalar spectral tilt and potential curvature to earlier tensor-based comparisons, then tests whether DBI tensor suppression changes the conclusion.

sources.title: What does inflation say about dark energy given the swampland conjectures?

evidence.text: Can inflationary observations restrict how far dark energy departs from a cosmological constant when common swampland parameters govern both sectors? A related question is whether a small total inflaton excursion still permits observable primordial tensors.

sources.title: Warm brane inflation with an exponential potential: a consistent realization away from the swampland

evidence.text: Can warm inflation with a steep exponential potential in the RS II braneworld achieve strong dissipation, exit inflation, and satisfy the observational and conjectured swampland restrictions discussed in the paper?

sources.title: Power Law Plateau Inflation Potential In The RS $II$ Braneworld Evading Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: How does the quadratic-density term in RS II change scalar-field expansion and slow roll relative to ordinary four-dimensional cosmology?

sources.title: Brane inflation: Swampland criteria, TCC, and reheating predictions

evidence.text: Which high-energy RSII brane-inflation potentials admit parameters compatible with the paper's observational comparison and swampland distance/gradient criteria, and how do reheating and TCC further restrict them?

sources.title: Rescaled Einstein-Hilbert Gravity from $f(R)$ Gravity: Inflation, Dark Energy and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can an exponential f(R) theory with a canonical scalar yield inflation compatible with both observational constraints and the paper's Swampland conditions through a rescaled Ricci term, while also supporting viable late-time acceleration?

sources.title: Rejuvenating the hope of a swampland consistent inflated multiverse with tachyonic inflation in the high-energy RS-II braneworld

evidence.text: How does the quadratic density correction in RS-II change the relationship between a tachyon potential and the Hubble expansion rate, compared with the ordinary GR low-energy limit?

sources.title: Reheating in small-field inflation on the brane: The Swampland Criteria and observational constraints in light of the PLANCK 2018 results

evidence.text: Can four small-field inflationary potentials in high-energy Randall–Sundrum II cosmology accommodate the paper's Planck constraints and swampland criteria, while yielding viable reheating and leptogenesis?

sources.title: Reheating in small-field inflation on the brane: The Swampland Criteria and observational constraints in light of the PLANCK 2018 results

evidence.text: Can four specified small-field potentials for a canonical scalar reproduce cosmological observations in the assumed high-energy RS-II regime while satisfying reheating and additional consistency requirements?

sources.title: Quintessential constant-roll inflation

evidence.text: Can a single-field Lorentzian quintessential-inflation model accommodate constant roll, observationally acceptable scalar and tensor spectra, and the paper's stated de Sitter swampland conditions while retaining asymptotic late-time acceleration?

sources.title: Constant-roll f(R) inflation compared with cosmic microwave background anisotropies and swampland criteria

evidence.text: Which sampled parameter choices in three constant-roll f(R) inflation models agree with historical CMB constraints, and how do their predictions compare with the paper's adopted swampland criteria?

sources.title: Cosmic Evolution of the Logarithmic f(R) Model and the dS Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can polynomial-plus-logarithmic f(R) gravity support constant-roll inflation with scalar spectral index ns and tensor-to-scalar ratio r compatible with Planck 2018, while satisfying the refined de Sitter swampland criterion?

sources.title: Swampland conjecture and inflation model from brane perspective

evidence.text: The application asks how the exponent p changes inflationary and potential-slope predictions when the f(R) modification is embedded in the paper’s brane prescription. The reported calculations keep γ fixed at one.

sources.title: Swampland conjecture and inflation model from brane perspective

evidence.text: Can an f(R) inflation model on a high-energy brane satisfy the paper’s swampland criteria and its observational comparisons simultaneously? The question concerns a proposed effective cosmological description; the paper does not construct its quantum-gravity completion.

sources.title: Warm inflation with bulk viscous pressure for different solutions of an anisotropic universe

evidence.text: How do anisotropy and bulk viscous pressure affect warm-inflation backgrounds, scalar/tensor observables, non-Gaussianity, and the paper's proposed swampland diagnostics for three expansion histories?

sources.title: Theories of gravity with nonminimal matter-curvature coupling and the de Sitter swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can nonminimal matter–curvature coupling reconcile single-field cold, slow-roll inflation with the de Sitter swampland conjectures, despite their familiar tension in General Relativity?

sources.title: Tsallis Holographic Inflation in f (R, T) Gravity: Planck/ACT Constraints, Reheating Dynamics, and Swampland Bounds

evidence.text: Can a Tsallis holographic energy density supply an effective inflaton potential in f(R,T) gravity while satisfying CMB constraints, reheating and primordial gravitational-wave bounds, and conjectural swampland criteria?

sources.title: Hamilton-Jacobi analysis of noncanonical inflation in f(R, T) gravity: Constraints from planck/ACT data, and theoretical bounds

evidence.text: Can noncanonical single-field inflation in linear f(R,T) gravity accommodate the paper's Planck/ACT constraints while satisfying reheating bounds from primordial gravitational waves, and how does it fare against swampland conjectures and the TCC?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture in string field inflation

evidence.text: Can nonlocal tachyonic string-field inflation satisfy the paper's de Sitter swampland tests, particularly the further refined conjecture, when expressed through inflationary observables and compared with Planck 2018-era constraints?

sources.title: Constant-roll inflation with tachyon field in the holographic braneworld

evidence.text: Can tachyon-driven constant-roll inflation on a holographic braneworld yield roughly 60 e-folds, Planck-compatible scalar and tensor observables, and compatibility with the stated swampland potential-slope criterion?

sources.title: Supersymmetric hybrid inflation in light of CMB experiments and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can SUSY hybrid inflation remain compatible with Planck 2018 while attaining a symmetry-breaking scale near 10^16 GeV, and can minimal or nonminimal Kähler versions satisfy modified swampland and trans-Planckian censorship conjectures?

sources.title: Warm non-minimally coupled Peccei–Quinn inflation and de Sitter Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can non-minimally coupled Peccei–Quinn warm inflation fit cosmological observations and satisfy de Sitter swampland criteria for inverse-temperature, field-linear, and temperature-linear dissipation?

sources.title: Reviving Motivated Inflationary Potentials with $K$-inflation in the light of ACT

evidence.text: Can field-dependent kinetic terms reconcile T-model and generalized natural inflation with the paper's ACT-DR6-era CMB constraints, while satisfying reheating bounds and producing testable gravitational waves? The motivating historical constraint quoted is ns=0.9743±0.0034; Swampland conjectures provide additional theoretical diagnostics.

sources.title: On finite time singularities in scalar field dark energy models based in the RS-II Braneworld

evidence.text: Would conformal-anomaly contributions or curvature-squared corrections remove any of the candidate singularities in this scalar RS-II model? The paper nominates these mechanisms from cited work but leaves the corrected cosmological problem unsolved.

sources.title: Modified F(R) Horava-Lifshitz gravity: a way to accelerating FRW cosmology

evidence.text: ADM decomposition and variation with respect to the spatial metric and projectable lapse produce the FRW evolution equation and global lapse constraint. Assuming standard matter conservation, the evolution equation is integrated to obtain a first Friedmann equation with C/a³.

sources.title: The zoo plot meets the swampland: mutual (in)consistency of single-field inflation, string conjectures, and cosmological data

evidence.text: Compute CMB predictions with CAMB, explore the likelihood with eight CosmoMC Metropolis–Hastings chains, apply R−1<0.05, and extract 68% and 95% probability contours for comparison with theoretical inequalities.

sources.title: What does inflation say about dark energy given the swampland conjectures?

evidence.text: Transfer a common inequality parameter from one physical sector to another after restricting it with observations. Here inflation constrains c and c', which are then used in a quintessence sector under an assumed common EFT.

sources.title: Warm brane inflation with an exponential potential: a consistent realization away from the swampland

evidence.text: Slow-roll reduction of the coupled inflaton, radiation, and modified Friedmann equations, followed by analysis of dissipation evolution in e-fold time and explicit numerical background evolution.

sources.title: Power Law Plateau Inflation Potential In The RS $II$ Braneworld Evading Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Match inflationary horizon crossing to today's temperature through reheating and radiation domination. Eliminate scale-factor ratios using entropy conservation, then solve for reheating duration and temperature from H_k, N_k, and V_end.

sources.title: Brane inflation: Swampland criteria, TCC, and reheating predictions

evidence.text: A numerical parameter search compares predicted (ns,r) with the historical Planck confidence regions, rather than testing only isolated parameter choices. The scalar amplitude then fixes remaining potential constants.

sources.title: Anisotropic constant-roll inflation with noncommutative model and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can a momentum-sector noncommutative deformation produce constant-roll scalar-field inflation and change the potential regions satisfying the paper's de Sitter swampland inequalities?

sources.title: Warm $\beta $-exponential inflation and the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can temperature-cubic dissipation make β-exponential inflation end, agree with the quoted CMB constraints in weak or strong dissipation, and satisfy the paper’s three swampland tests?

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland dS Conjecture in Mimetic f(G) Gravity

evidence.text: Can a reconstructed slow-roll inflation model in mimetic f(G) gravity match the paper's observational benchmarks while satisfying the refined or further refined de Sitter swampland conjecture?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures in hybrid metric-Palatini gravity

evidence.text: The potential family tests whether changing the exponent away from the previously discussed quadratic case can improve simultaneous inflationary and swampland compatibility in the hybrid model.

sources.title: Revisiting Scalar Tensor inflation by swampland criteria and Reheating

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent gravitational coupling accommodate slow-roll inflation, the observed scalar/tensor spectra, and the paper's swampland cuts? The study also asks which effective reheating equations of state give positive, relatively short expansion histories.

sources.title: Power Law Plateau Inflation Potential In The RS $II$ Braneworld Evading Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Which combinations of the potential scale, plateau mass, exponents, five-dimensional Planck mass, and reheating parameters are preferred or excluded by a direct observational analysis?

sources.title: Swampland diagnostics and observational tests of the inflationary universe in the Palatini formalism

evidence.text: How do the potential exponent and assumed inflationary duration affect CMB predictions and five distinct swampland diagnostics in an inherited quadratic Palatini model of quintessential inflation?

sources.title: $\alpha$-attractor from superconformal E-models in brane inflation

evidence.text: Do superconformal E-model potentials retain inflationary attractors in Randall–Sundrum II brane cosmology, and how do brane corrections affect ns, r, parameter degeneracies and sub-Planckian field excursions?

sources.title: The de Sitter Swampland Conjectures in the Context of Chaplygin-Inspired Inflation

evidence.text: Can generalized Chaplygin-inspired single-field inflation satisfy the de Sitter swampland conditions, and how do these conditions further restrict inflationary potentials already constrained by CMB comparisons?

sources.title: Warm tachyon inflation and swampland criteria

evidence.text: Determine whether observational compatibility survives checks of thermal dominance and strong dissipation, and whether the resulting tachyon trajectories satisfy the paper's two proposed swampland inequalities.

sources.title: Warm inflation within a supersymmetric distributed mass model

evidence.text: Which mass distributions in a supersymmetric distributed mass model permit controlled warm inflation with a quartic potential, observational agreement, and compatibility with the proposed swampland criteria?

sources.title: Logarithmic corrected $f(R)$ gravitational model and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Determine whether corrected f(R) inflation can accommodate the paper's conjectured quantum-gravity restrictions and reported cosmological information, and whether those requirements constrain the curvature exponent and correction coefficients.

sources.title: Swampland Criteria and Constraints on Inflation in a $f(R,T)$ Gravity Theory

evidence.text: Can canonical-scalar inflation in the specified linear f(R,T) model satisfy the paper's Planck 2018 cuts together with its implementation of swampland criteria, and which potential parameters permit overlap?

sources.title: A note on supergravity inflation in braneworld

evidence.text: Can supergravity-motivated power-law potentials with exponential suppression yield observationally compatible inflation and sub-Planckian field excursions when embedded phenomenologically in braneworld cosmology?

sources.title: Multi-field cold and warm inflation and the de Sitter swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Under what conditions can quasi-exponential inflation driven by multiple scalar fields with canonical kinetic terms satisfy the paper's de Sitter swampland slope and curvature conditions, and how does dissipation change compatibility?

sources.title: Implications of single field inflation in general cosmological scenarios on the nature of dark energy given the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can the same swampland requirements used during cold single-field inflation allow a measurable late-time departure from w=-1 when the expansion law differs from GR? The paper asks whether the original gradient conjecture suffices without changing conjecture branches during inflation.

sources.title: Swampland conjectures in hybrid metric-Palatini gravity

evidence.text: Does a power-law-potential realization of hybrid metric-Palatini inflation admit a common regime satisfying cosmological observations and the paper's de Sitter swampland inequalities? The proposed test uses ns, r, and potential-derivative ratios.

sources.title: Logarithmic corrected $f(R)$ gravitational model and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: How would the model's conjecture comparison change under constant-roll inflationary dynamics?

sources.title: Constraints on cosmological parameters in light of the scalar–tensor theory of gravity and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can power-law, exponential and logarithmic inflationary models in nonminimally coupled scalar–tensor gravity satisfy the paper's de Sitter swampland conditions while producing cosmological parameters compatible with its observational benchmarks?

sources.title: Theory of gravity with nonminimal matter-nonmetricity coupling and the de-Sitter swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can nonminimal matter–nonmetricity coupling reconcile single-scalar slow-roll inflation with the de Sitter swampland criteria?

sources.title: Swampland dS conjecture in mimetic $f(R, T)$ gravity

evidence.text: Can reconstructed inflationary histories in mimetic f(R,T)=R+δT gravity satisfy observational constraints and refined or further-refined de Sitter swampland criteria?

sources.title: Two-field inflationary model and swampland de Sitter conjecture

evidence.text: Can a canonical two-field model with a Hubble function linear in the fields meet a de Sitter swampland criterion and produce acceptable scalar tilt and tensor amplitude? The paper addresses this through analytic formulas and qualitative parameter scans.

sources.title: Constant-roll brane inflation

evidence.text: How does the high-energy RSII expansion law change constant-roll inflation, its primordial perturbations, and its compatibility with observations and conjectured quantum-gravity restrictions?

sources.title: Disentangling the $f(R)$ - Duality

evidence.text: How do decaying exponentials, rising exponentials, and monomial deformations of inflationary plateaus change their f(R) descriptions, including asymptotic powers, closed-form reconstructibility, and observable inflationary behavior?

destination.title: Inflationary dynamics, cosmic relics and gravitational-wave signatures
destination.question: How do inflationary models and adjacent cosmological mechanisms generate and constrain CMB signatures, primordial black holes, particle relics and gravitational waves?
destination.summary: A broad navigation family with separate questions for inflationary viability, scalar enhancement, gauge-sourced tensors, gravitational-wave production and transfer, cosmological prehistory, quantum backgrounds, matter production and late-time cosmology.

systems: Inflationary effective theories, string and supergravity constructions
Axion, gauge, scalar-tensor and modified-gravity models
Quantum-background proposals and explicit alternatives without inflation
Adjacent late-time scalar and axion systems
targets: Directly sourced and subsequently amplified gravitational waves
Particle dark matter, baryon asymmetry and dark energy
Background origin, lifetime, stability and exit
assumptions: Model assumptions remain local to each source.
Observational compatibility and detector reach retain their source dates.
Quantum-gravity conjectures are conditional context, not family-wide premises.
conventions: No common spacetime dimension, quantum state, metric signature or collapse prescription is imposed.
includes: Methods, reviews and pedagogical context with explicit contribution roles
Alternate homes for sources outside an inflationary signal-generation core
excludes: Treating numerical membership as scientific equivalence
Inferring detections or physical source identification from illustrative compatibility
Assuming every PBH population survives as dark matter
Treating every gravitational-wave mechanism as scalar induced

sources.title: Sharp Predictions from Eternal Inflation Patches in D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a quantum-state measure turn broad distributions of CMB observables in warped D3-brane inflation into sharp predictions, and do slow-roll eternal-inflation patches exist once flux-induced potential terms and all six brane coordinates are included?

sources.title: Double Monodromy Inflation: A Gravity Waves Factory for CMB-S4, LiteBIRD and LISA

evidence.text: Can two short axion-monodromy inflationary stages with restricted field excursions fit CMB observations while producing detectable gravitational waves at both CMB and interferometer wavelengths?

sources.title: General double monodromy inflation

evidence.text: Can interrupted monodromy inflation remain compatible with the paper-era CMB bounds when strong-coupling kinetic corrections are included, and what correlated non-Gaussianity and shorter-wavelength gravitational-wave signatures result?

sources.title: Inflection-point inflation and dark matter redux

evidence.text: Can two phenomenological small-field, near-inflection-point inflation potentials satisfy the paper's CMB constraints and produce all cold dark matter through perturbative inflaton decay, while respecting radiative stability, reheating, BBN and Lyman-α restrictions?

sources.title: Implications of quantum gravity for dark matter in the brane-world scenario

evidence.text: Do quantum-gravity consistency conjectures exclude branon dark matter while favoring massive KK gauge boson dark matter, and can inflationary production make the latter observable through CMB and primordial gravitational waves?

sources.title: Primordial gravitational waves in non-minimally coupled chromo-natural inflation

evidence.text: Can an axion kinetic coupling to the Einstein tensor restore chromo-natural inflation's compatibility with CMB observations while preserving its field content, symmetry structure, and potentially observable chiral gravitational waves?

sources.title: Primordial black holes and secondary gravitational waves from generalized power-law non-canonical inflation with quartic potential

evidence.text: Can quartic inflation with a field-dependent non-canonical mass scale satisfy CMB constraints while transiently enhancing small-scale curvature perturbations enough to generate primordial black holes and secondary gravitational waves?

sources.title: Gravitational wave signatures from reheating in axion-Chern-Simons running-vacuum cosmology

evidence.text: Can axion-driven matter-dominated reheating in Chern-Simons running-vacuum cosmology generate observable scalar-induced gravitational waves, and can logarithmic curvature corrections distinguish their spectrum from the GR prediction?

sources.title: On Legacy of Starobinsky Inflation

evidence.text: How does Starobinsky inflation fare as a gravitational effective theory when confronted with CMB observations, primordial-black-hole production, quantum-gravity conjectures, string corrections and reheating? This memorial contribution primarily reviews existing results.

sources.title: Inflation from Anomalies

evidence.text: Can chiral gravitational waves generate a gravitational Chern–Simons condensate that drives finite-duration inflation with a gravitational axion? The review examines possible wave sources, quantum-ordering-dependent vacuum instability and periodic potential modulations needed for slow-roll phenomenology.

sources.title: Inflation and the theory of cosmological perturbations

evidence.text: How can inflation address the horizon, flatness and entropy problems while generating quantum perturbations that seed cosmic structure, CMB anisotropies and gravitational waves?

sources.title: Observational consequences of a landscape

evidence.text: Could a landscape tunneling origin leave observable negative spatial curvature or large-scale CMB signatures, and does conditioning on structure formation make sufficiently long inflation statistically plausible?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: What explains inflationary initial conditions, protects potential flatness, transfers energy into the hot Big Bang, and defines predictions across differently evolving causally separated regions?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Can a microscopic theory justify the approximations and initial conditions behind inflation, preserve its fluctuation predictions, and explain energy transfer into observed particles?

sources.title: Inflation

evidence.text: How can accelerated expansion address FRW initial-condition puzzles, generate primordial structure from quantum fluctuations, and connect observable perturbations to inflationary dynamics and fundamental physics?

sources.title: Holography for Cosmology

evidence.text: Can primordial cosmological observables be encoded operationally in a three-dimensional QFT, reproducing perturbative inflation where applicable and providing calculable models when early gravitational dynamics are strongly coupled?

sources.title: Inflation and the cosmological (not-so) constant in unimodular gravity

evidence.text: Can energy-momentum nonconservation in unimodular gravity drive inflation without a fundamental inflaton, produce suitable radiation-fluid primordial perturbations, end smoothly in radiation domination, and yield a dynamical cosmological term with a plausible present magnitude?

sources.title: Cosmic inflation in an extended non-commutative foliated quantum gravity: the wave function of the universe

evidence.text: Can a three-field noncommutative extension of branch-cut quantum gravity connect an inflaton-type field with the universe's wave function and explain accelerated expansion through a reconfiguration of primordial matter, energy and spacetime?

sources.title: Running Vacuum and H$^{4}$ Inflation

evidence.text: Can quantum matter effects in FLRW spacetime supply an H⁴ contribution that drives inflation without a supplementary inflaton and connects continuously to radiation domination, within the same running-vacuum framework used for late dark energy?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Specify component equations of state and initial densities, integrate conservation separately, sum densities, and integrate the Friedmann equation. Equality epochs follow by equating component densities rather than by assuming continued single-component dominance through the transition.

sources.title: Inflation

evidence.text: Spherical harmonics and transfer-function integrals connect primordial spectra to CMB angular correlations. Leading non-Gaussian effects require cubic interactions; their detailed derivation is largely replaced by a review of results.

sources.title: Holography for Cosmology

evidence.text: Linear mode equations, Bunch-Davies boundary conditions and canonical Wronskians determine normalized perturbations. Linear response functions are then introduced through Π^(ζ)=Ωζ and Π^(γ)=Eγ, expressing power spectra through their late-time imaginary parts.

sources.title: Sharp Predictions from Eternal Inflation Patches in D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Uses compact regular semiclassical NBWF saddles, WKB classical histories and probabilities proportional to exp(-2IR). Bottom-up history probabilities are conditioned on at least one occurrence of ultralocal observer data to obtain top-down probabilities for local observables.

sources.title: Double Monodromy Inflation: A Gravity Waves Factory for CMB-S4, LiteBIRD and LISA

evidence.text: Estimate ΩGW from metric and vector-sourced tensors evaluated at horizon crossing, then map first-stage exit times to present frequency using kCMB=0.002 Mpc^−1. Adopt ΩGW=Ωr,0 ΔT²/24 with Ωr,0=8.6×10^−5.

sources.title: General double monodromy inflation

evidence.text: Numerically integrate slow-roll evolution with the full chosen K(X), then use the inflationary Goldstone EFT through cubic order to compute power spectra and bispectra. The relevant cubic operators are π̇(∂π)² and π̇³, related to equilateral and orthogonal templates.

sources.title: How accidental was inflation?

evidence.text: How sensitively do supergravity inflation models depend on relative couplings, and can small departures from their Starobinsky or new-inflation limits improve CMB agreement while alleviating large-field initial-condition problems? The focus is potential-flatness tuning rather than the overall inflationary hierarchy.

sources.title: Non-Gaussianity from Axion Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: Can small periodic corrections to a linear axion-monodromy inflationary potential produce observable primordial non-Gaussianity while leaving little detectable structure in the scalar power spectrum?

sources.title: Semiclassical predictions regarding a preinflationary era and its effects on the power spectrum

evidence.text: Does semiclassical gravity favor a radiation-dominated preinflationary era, and how would that era and the initial quantum state affect primordial and large-angle CMB power?

sources.title: Gravitational Waves from Axion Monodromy

evidence.text: Can post-inflationary fluctuations populate multiple minima of an axion-monodromy potential within one Hubble patch, and can subsequent bubble collisions generate an observable gravitational-wave signal?

sources.title: Primordial black holes from a type-IIB/F theory inflaton potential

evidence.text: Can an earlier type-IIB/F slow-roll inflaton potential, supplemented by a localized correction motivated by a Kähler-modulus deformation, generate transient ultra-slow roll (USR), enhanced curvature perturbations, and an observationally allowed PBH abundance?

sources.title: Hypermagnetic Fields and Baryon Asymmetry from Pseudoscalar Inflation

evidence.text: Can helical hypermagnetic fields generated during pseudoscalar inflation produce the baryon asymmetry through the Standard Model anomaly, constrain natural inflation, and connect baryon number to relic magnetic helicity?

sources.title: Dark energy, D-branes and pulsar timing arrays

evidence.text: Can post-inflationary, disformally coupled DBI scalar evolution amplify primordial gravitational waves into the PTA band, while the same scalar subsequently supplies early and late dark energy?

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: How can an inflationary spectrum normalized on CMB scales become sufficiently large on much smaller scales to seed PBHs?

sources.title: Observable Chiral Gravitational Waves from Inflation in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a spectator axion–non-Abelian gauge sector in type IIB compactifications produce observable chiral primordial gravitational waves during small-field inflation while preserving moduli stabilization and host inflationary dynamics?

sources.title: Secondary GWs and PBHs in string inflation: formation and detectability

evidence.text: Can Fibre Inflation produce primordial black holes consistently with CMB constraints, and can the associated scalar-induced gravitational waves remain detectable when the PBH dark-matter abundance is negligible?

sources.title: Sharp turns in axion monodromy: primordial black holes and gravitational waves

evidence.text: Can transient slow-roll violations generate repeated sharp turns in supergravity without large field-space curvature, and can the resulting scalar enhancement produce primordial black holes and detectable induced gravitational waves?

sources.title: Primordial black holes from single field models of inflation

evidence.text: Can a single-field inflationary potential generate sufficiently enhanced small-scale curvature fluctuations to produce primordial black holes constituting all dark matter, while retaining agreement with the paper's CMB and LSS constraints?

sources.title: Primordial black holes and gravitational waves in multiaxion-Chern-Simons inflation

evidence.text: Can world-sheet-instanton modulations in two-axion Chern-Simons cosmology amplify scalar perturbations enough to generate substantial primordial-black-hole dark matter and potentially observable induced gravitational waves? How do the signatures depend on the potential hierarchy and reheating history?

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: Can transitions among several inflationary phases generate distinct PBH populations at stellar, earth, and asteroid masses, with abundances suitable for proposed gravitational-wave, microlensing, and dark-matter interpretations?

sources.title: Primordial Black Holes from String Inflation

evidence.text: Can a string-derived, effectively single-field inflationary potential produce a sufficiently large small-scale curvature spectrum to generate low-mass primordial black holes constituting a significant dark-matter fraction, while confronting CMB constraints and controlling quantum corrections?

sources.title: Loop quantum cosmology, non-Gaussianity, and CMB power asymmetry

evidence.text: Can a pre-inflationary LQC bounce generate correlations between observable and super-Hubble modes that yield a large-scale, predominantly dipolar CMB power modulation while remaining compatible with the observational constraints discussed in 2015?

sources.title: What would we learn by detecting a gravitational wave signal in the cosmic microwave background anisotropy?

evidence.text: What would detecting inflationary gravitational waves in CMB anisotropy imply for the inflaton field excursion, potential height, and compatibility with particle-physics models?

sources.title: Hubble-scale tachyonic shocks from low-scale inflation — A new gravitational-wave window on inflation

evidence.text: Can sufficiently low-scale single-field inflation produce nonlinear tachyonic structures before coherent inflaton oscillations, with Hubble-scale bubble-like collisions generating gravitational waves accessible to existing and proposed detectors?

sources.title: One-loop corrections to the E-type <math display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math>-attractor models of inflation and primordial black hole production

evidence.text: Do cubic-interaction one-loop corrections remain perturbatively small in generalized E-type α-attractor models producing primordial black holes, and can their induced gravitational-wave spectra support a conditional reconstruction of the inflationary potential?

sources.title: Mechanisms for Primordial Black Hole Production in String Theory

evidence.text: Can string-inspired single-field inflation amplify small-scale curvature power enough to produce significant primordial black hole dark matter while remaining compatible with CMB observations?

sources.title: Twisting inflation to sub-Planckian axion decay constants

evidence.text: Can shift-symmetric pseudoscalar couplings to gravitational topological densities, with torsion allowed, support viable inflation at sub-Planckian axion decay constants, and what stability and primordial-spectrum signatures result?

sources.title: Extranatural Inflation Redux

evidence.text: Can additional light charged bulk fermions improve the CMB predictions of minimal extranatural inflation, potentially matching Starobinsky-like observables, and what parameters and gauge coupling would then be required?

sources.title: Gauge fields and inflation: Chiral gravitational waves, fluctuations, and the Lyth bound

evidence.text: How does an inflationary non-Abelian gauge background modify scalar and tensor fluctuations, generate gravitational-wave chirality, and affect the naive Lyth argument and observational viability of Chromo-Natural Inflation?

sources.title: String-Inspired Running Vacuum—The “Vacuumon”—And the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: What potential and quantum scalar mode describe the gravitational-wave condensate, and can negative inflationary ν generate a distinguishable cosmological signal?

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: How are enhanced primordial perturbations converted into a PBH abundance? The paper approximates nonlinear radiation-era collapse by a constant comoving-density threshold applied to rare overdense Hubble patches.

sources.title: Primordial Gravitational Waves from Axion-Gauge Fields Dynamics

evidence.text: Can an axion–SU(2) spectator sector generate observable chiral primordial gravitational waves while keeping curvature perturbations compatible with observations and weakening the usual inference of inflationary energy scale from r?

sources.title: Primordial Black Holes Generated by Fast-roll Mechanism in Noncanonical Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can a field-dependent noncanonical mass scale generate a transient fast-roll stage in natural inflation, enhancing scalar perturbations enough to produce PBHs and induced gravitational waves while retaining acceptable CMB predictions?

sources.title: Spatial Curvature Falsifies Eternal Inflation

evidence.text: Can the observed low CMB multipoles constrain locally measured spatial curvature tightly enough that a sufficiently large curvature measurement would falsify a specified eternal-inflation history?

sources.title: Primordial black holes in non-minimal Gauss–Bonnet inflation in light of the PTA data

evidence.text: Can a two-part inflaton–Gauss–Bonnet coupling make monomial inflation compatible with CMB constraints while enhancing small-scale curvature perturbations enough for PBHs and scalar-induced gravitational waves, including a possible PTA signal?

sources.title: Inflationary dynamics of non-minimally coupled f(R) matter-curvature theories

evidence.text: Can power-law nonminimal matter-curvature couplings support stable inflation, how do their full background dynamics change CMB predictions, and can they resolve the graceful-exit problem of old inflation?

sources.title: Axions, Black Holes and the Detection of Gravitons: from Astrophysics to Cosmology

evidence.text: Could macroscopic superradiant axion clouds amplify entangled graviton squeezing enough for interferometric tests, and could quantum chiral gravitational waves leave indirect cosmological signatures through gravitational Chern–Simons condensates?

sources.title: Is the NANOGrav signal a hint of dS decay during inflation?

evidence.text: Can an inflationary first-order transition leave a low-frequency gravitational-wave spectrum compatible with a PTA common-spectrum signal, despite occurring at a high energy scale?

sources.title: Brane-vector dark matter and its connection to inflation and primordial gravitational waves

evidence.text: Can a massive vector generated by a fluctuating brane supply dark matter through inflationary production, and connect its mass to CMB observables, reheating and primordial gravitational waves?

sources.title: Spectator axions in string inflation and primordial black holes

evidence.text: Do the two light spectator axions intrinsic to Fibre Inflation preserve or alter the small-scale curvature enhancement used to seed primordial black holes, and can their coupled dynamics assist PBH formation while retaining acceptable CMB predictions?

sources.title: Primordial black holes dark matter and secondary gravitational waves from warm Higgs-G inflation

evidence.text: Can Galileon-dominated warm Higgs inflation simultaneously fit large-scale CMB observations, amplify small-scale fluctuations enough for primordial-black-hole dark matter, and generate detectable scalar-induced gravitational waves?

sources.title: Gravity waves and primordial black holes in scalar warm little inflation

evidence.text: Can scalar Warm Little Inflation amplify small-scale curvature fluctuations near the end of quartic inflation enough to generate primordial black holes and an appreciable second-order gravitational-wave background while satisfying CMB constraints?

sources.title: Primordial Black Holes from a tiny bump/dip in the Inflaton potential

evidence.text: Can tiny localized bumps or dips in a single-field inflaton potential amplify small-scale curvature perturbations enough to produce substantial primordial-black-hole abundances across widely separated masses while retaining acceptable CMB observables?

sources.title: Testing String Theory with CMB

evidence.text: What would detecting primordial CMB tensors imply for string inflation, moduli stabilization, and the gravitino mass, particularly in models based on the simplest KKLT construction?

sources.title: Quantum Compositeness of Gravity: Black Holes, AdS and Inflation

evidence.text: Can gravitational backgrounds emerge from quantum graviton composites, and can finite constituent number explain radiation, constrain semiclassical lifetimes, and retain information about early inflation?

sources.title: Open inflation in the landscape

evidence.text: Can small residual spatial curvature, 1−Ω0≈10^−3–10^−2, reveal high-energy bubble nucleation through large-angle tensor CMB anisotropies, despite a much lower subsequent slow-roll inflation scale?

sources.title: The rise of the primordial tensor spectrum from an early scalar-tensor epoch

evidence.text: Can a post-inflationary, pre-BBN scalar-tensor epoch enhance primordial gravitational waves, and can conformal versus disformal couplings produce distinguishable spectral shapes within future interferometer bands?

sources.title: On chromonatural inflation in string theory

evidence.text: Can spectator chromonatural inflation be embedded in type IIB Kähler inflation while sustaining the background gauge field, amplifying primordial tensors to potentially observable levels, and controlling gauge-fluctuation backreaction?

sources.title: Completely dark matter from rapid-turn multifield inflation

evidence.text: Can purely gravitational production of a massive scalar explain dark matter in CMB-compatible rapid-turn inflation with curved or flat field space?

sources.title: Primordial black holes and associated gravitational waves in axion monodromy inflation

evidence.text: Can periodic modulations and gauge-particle production in axion monodromy inflation generate primordial black holes of astrophysical interest while preserving the paper's historical CMB constraints, and what gravitational-wave signals accompany the selected examples?

destinations.title: What explains inflationary initial conditions, protects potential flatness, transfers energy into the hot Big Bang, and defines predictions across differently evolving causally separated regions?
Can a microscopic theory justify the approximations and initial conditions behind inflation, preserve its fluctuation predictions, and explain energy transfer into observed particles?

How can accelerated expansion address FRW initial-condition puzzles, generate primordial structure from quantum fluctuations, and connect observable perturbations to inflationary dynamics and fundamental physics?

Can primordial cosmological observables be encoded operationally in a three-dimensional QFT, reproducing perturbative inflation where applicable and providing calculable models when early gravitational dynamics are strongly coupled?

Can a quantum-state measure turn broad distributions of CMB observables in warped D3-brane inflation into sharp predictions, and do slow-roll eternal-inflation patches exist once flux-induced potential terms and all six brane coordinates are included?
Can two short axion-monodromy inflationary stages with restricted field excursions fit CMB observations while producing detectable gravitational waves at both CMB and interferometer wavelengths?

Can interrupted monodromy inflation remain compatible with the paper-era CMB bounds when strong-coupling kinetic corrections are included, and what correlated non-Gaussianity and shorter-wavelength gravitational-wave signatures result?

Can energy-momentum nonconservation in unimodular gravity drive inflation without a fundamental inflaton, produce suitable radiation-fluid primordial perturbations, end smoothly in radiation domination, and yield a dynamical cosmological term with a plausible present magnitude?

Can two phenomenological small-field, near-inflection-point inflation potentials satisfy the paper's CMB constraints and produce all cold dark matter through perturbative inflaton decay, while respecting radiative stability, reheating, BBN and Lyman-α restrictions?

Do quantum-gravity consistency conjectures exclude branon dark matter while favoring massive KK gauge boson dark matter, and can inflationary production make the latter observable through CMB and primordial gravitational waves?

Can an axion kinetic coupling to the Einstein tensor restore chromo-natural inflation's compatibility with CMB observations while preserving its field content, symmetry structure, and potentially observable chiral gravitational waves?

Can quartic inflation with a field-dependent non-canonical mass scale satisfy CMB constraints while transiently enhancing small-scale curvature perturbations enough to generate primordial black holes and secondary gravitational waves?

Can a three-field noncommutative extension of branch-cut quantum gravity connect an inflaton-type field with the universe's wave function and explain accelerated expansion through a reconfiguration of primordial matter, energy and spacetime?

Can axion-driven matter-dominated reheating in Chern-Simons running-vacuum cosmology generate observable scalar-induced gravitational waves, and can logarithmic curvature corrections distinguish their spectrum from the GR prediction?

How does Starobinsky inflation fare as a gravitational effective theory when confronted with CMB observations, primordial-black-hole production, quantum-gravity conjectures, string corrections and reheating? This memorial contribution primarily reviews existing results.

Can quantum matter effects in FLRW spacetime supply an H⁴ contribution that drives inflation without a supplementary inflaton and connects continuously to radiation domination, within the same running-vacuum framework used for late dark energy?

Can chiral gravitational waves generate a gravitational Chern–Simons condensate that drives finite-duration inflation with a gravitational axion? The review examines possible wave sources, quantum-ordering-dependent vacuum instability and periodic potential modulations needed for slow-roll phenomenology.
How can inflation address the horizon, flatness and entropy problems while generating quantum perturbations that seed cosmic structure, CMB anisotropies and gravitational waves?

Could a landscape tunneling origin leave observable negative spatial curvature or large-scale CMB signatures, and does conditioning on structure formation make sufficiently long inflation statistically plausible?
